title: The Glitch Is Me
visualIdentity: A melancholic, psychedelic digital afterlife where organic water, bone, glass and fabric merge with restrained computational artifacts. The world feels haunted rather than technological: tactile, wet, slow, elegant and emotionally human.
protagonist: The Quantum Siren: one consistent adult woman with an ageless but clearly adult presence, expressive dark eyes, translucent pale skin with subtle signal fractures, long black hair moving as if underwater, and flowing charcoal fabric. She is never a celebrity, never a real person, and never presented as a literal robot.
